about_the_game:
Do you ever feel like:

  • Going to work is a punishment

  • Talking to people is exhausting

  • Sending a sticker is better than speaking

Then you need this —
“Gummy Bear: I Feel Nothing About Anything” Sticker Pack

Includes:

  • indifferent.png

  • speechless.png

  • too_lazy_to_get_angry_but_here’s_a_token_effort.png

  • typing_indicator_but_I_won’t_reply.png

  • slept_woke_up_still_wanna_sleep.png

This isn’t just a sticker pack.
It’s the primitive language of your soul,
spoken through the jelly-like dead-fish eyes
that gently surrender to the world.

Characters: Gummy Bear, Little Gummy
